1) Background / Context
The project involves the development of a technology-focused community platform for link aggregation and discussion, similar to Hacker News. The platform, named Lobsters, is designed to cater primarily to enthusiasts and professionals in technology, programming, and computer science. It operates with an invite-only model to ensure high-quality content and discourse.

 2) Objectives
- To provide a platform for sharing and discussing links related to technology, programming, and computer science.
- To maintain a high standard of content quality through an invite-only membership system.
- To enhance community transparency with a public moderation log.
- To facilitate community replication by operating as open-source software.

 3) Stakeholders & Users
- Community Members: Users who submit links and participate in discussions.
- Moderators: Users responsible for content moderation and maintaining community standards.
- Administrators: Users with elevated privileges to manage platform operations.
- Visitors: Non-members who can view content but not participate.

 4) Functional Descriptions
- User Registration and Management: Support for invite-based user registration and profile management.
- Content Submission: Users can submit links to articles, research papers, and blog posts.
- Discussion Threads: Users can engage in threaded discussions related to submitted content.
- Voting System: Users can vote on stories and comments to influence content visibility.
- Tagging System: Stories can be tagged for improved categorization and searchability.
- Story Moderation: Tools for moderators to manage content quality, including moderation logs.
- Messaging System: Direct messaging capabilities for communication between members.
- Story and Comment Management: Functions for saving, hiding, and moderating stories and comments.

 5) Non-Functional Descriptions
- Scalability: The platform should efficiently support growth in user base and content volume.
- Security: Implementation of robust security measures, including encrypted passwords and data protection.
- Performance: Ensuring low latency for user interactions, even with increased load.
- Transparency: Access to public moderation logs to uphold community standards.
- Usability: Intuitive user interface and navigation to promote ease of use.
- Open-Source Accessibility: Available for other communities to replicate and adapt.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0150

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password_digest` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `is_admin` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_moderator` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `banned_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `banned_reason` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `invited_by_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `invitation_code` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `about` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `homepage` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `avatar_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `karma` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `last_login_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`),
  CONSTRAINT `users_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`invited_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `invitations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `code` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `accepted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `code` (`code`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tags` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `stories` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `url` varchar(2048) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `short_id` char(6) NOT NULL,
  `score` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `comment_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `is_expired` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_moderated` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `moderated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `moderated_by_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `moderation_reason` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `short_id` (`short_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `moderated_by_user_id` (`moderated_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `stories_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `stories_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`moderated_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `story_tags` (
  `story_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `tag_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`story_id`, `tag_id`),
  KEY `tag_id` (`tag_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `story_tags_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`story_id`) REFERENCES `stories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `story_tags_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`tag_id`) REFERENCES `tags` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `comments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `story_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `parent_comment_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `short_id` char(6) NOT NULL,
  `score` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_moderated` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `moderated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `moderated_by_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `moderation_reason` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `short_id` (`short_id`),
  KEY `story_id` (`story_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `parent_comment_id` (`parent_comment_id`),
  KEY `moderated_by_user_id` (`moderated_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `comments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`story_id`) REFERENCES `stories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `comments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `comments_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_comment_id`) REFERENCES `comments` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `comments_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`moderated_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `votes` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `story_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `comment_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `vote` tinyint(4) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `story_id` (`story_id`),
  KEY `comment_id` (`comment_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `votes_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `votes_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`story_id`) REFERENCES `stories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `votes_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`comment_id`) REFERENCES `comments` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `saved_stories` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `story_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `user_story` (`user_id`, `story_id`),
  KEY `story_id` (`story_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `saved_stories_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `saved_stories_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`story_id`) REFERENCES `stories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `hidden_stories` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `story_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `user_story` (`user_id`, `story_id`),
  KEY `story_id` (`story_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `hidden_stories_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `hidden_stories_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`story_id`) REFERENCES `stories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `moderation_logs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `moderator_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `story_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `comment_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `is_public` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `moderator_user_id` (`moderator_user_id`),
  KEY `story_id` (`story_id`),
  KEY `comment_id` (`comment_id`),
  KEY `target_user_id` (`target_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `moderation_logs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`moderator_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `moderation_logs_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`story_id`) REFERENCES `stories` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `moderation_logs_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`comment_id`) REFERENCES `comments` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `moderation_logs_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`target_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `messages` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sender_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `recipient_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `read_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_by_sender` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `deleted_by_recipient` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `sender_user_id` (`sender_user_id`),
  KEY `recipient_user_id` (`recipient_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `messages_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`sender_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `messages_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`recipient_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tag_filters` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `tag_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `user_tag` (`user_id`, `tag_id`),
  KEY `tag_id` (`tag_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tag_filters_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tag_filters_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`tag_id`) REFERENCES `tags` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
